hostApply.title: Co-create an experience with Gharmish.
hostApply.intro: Gharmish is a partnership marketplace, not a passive listing site. We work alongside you on photography, training, and distribution — and we share the upside fairly. Tell us about yourself to start the conversation.
hostApply.introMeta: Submitting this form doesn't list anything yet. Our partnerships team reviews each application and follows up to discuss insurance, payouts, and the experience you'd love to host.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: How you'd like to appear to guests — your full name or your company's brand name.

bio.label: Short bio (English)
bio.hint: A paragraph or two on who you are and what you love about Asir. We'll have it translated to Arabic with you. Minimum 40 characters.

languages.label: Languages you host in
languages.hint: Pick at least one. You can add more later.

identityNumber.label: Identity number
identityNumber.hint: 10-digit Saudi national ID, Iqama, or commercial registration number. We verify this before any listing goes live.

contactPhone.label: Phone
contactPhone.hint: Pulled from your account. The partnerships team confirms on WhatsApp.

contactEmail.label: Email (optional)
contactEmail.hint: If you'd rather we reach you by email for the first conversation.

pending.title: We've got your application, {name}.
pending.description: Our partnerships team reviews each application personally — usually within a week. We'll be in touch on WhatsApp to set up a call.

approved.title: Welcome to Gharmish, {name}.
approved.description: Your application has been approved. The team will reach out with next steps — bank details, insurance, and your first experience.

rejected.title: We can't move forward yet, {name}.
rejected.description: Our team left a note on your application. You can update your details and resubmit when you're ready.

submitted.title: Thank you — we've got it from here.
submitted.description: Your application is on the partnerships team's desk. We review every one personally, so you'll hear back within a week.
submitted.step1: We review your application and get in touch on WhatsApp to schedule a short call.
submitted.step2: If we're a fit, we'll talk through insurance, payouts, and the experience you'd love to host.
submitted.step3: You'll get a host account with the tools to draft your first listing — and we'll co-produce the photography.

errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.server: We couldn't submit your application. Try again in a moment.
errors.authRequired: Sign in again to submit your application.

fields.bioShort: Tell us a little more — at least 40 characters.
fields.identityInvalid: Enter a 10-digit national ID, Iqama, or CR number.

hostDashboard.suspendedBanner: Your host account is currently suspended by the team. Every live experience has been paused. We'll be in touch on WhatsApp to resolve this — for urgent questions, reply to your last message from us.

whatsNext.title: Get ready to host.
whatsNext.step1Description: Tools for hosts to draft and submit experiences open soon. Until then, share your idea with the partnerships team and we'll co-produce it with you.
whatsNext.step2Description: We bring the camera. Our photographer captures the place, the moments, and you — natural light, no filters.
whatsNext.step3Description: Once your listing is approved, it appears in the catalog and bookings open. We'll text you the first time someone books.

empty.title: No experiences yet.
empty.description: Start with a draft — you can save and come back any time. Submitting for review gets your listing into the public catalog after we approve it.

new.title: Draft your experience.
new.intro: Start with a working title and a paragraph or two. You can save as a draft and refine it before publishing.
new.arabicNotice: Arabic title and description are added by the partnerships team before your listing goes live. Write your draft in English for now.

edit.liveEditWarning: Heads up — this listing is live. Saving any changes will pull it off the catalog until we re-approve the updated version.
